scenarios.scenario: Earlier weekday wake
scenarios.trigger: For an opted-in user with a confirmed local wake schedule and a canonical dynamic planning-need estimate whose actual source day, model and fallback tier are retained, evaluate the current plan revision; the next selected weekday wake is at least 60 minutes earlier than the preceding selected wake, and its calculated bedtime has not passed.
scenarios.context: An early obligation changes the time available tonight and calls for reviewing bedtime in advance.
scenarios.title: Plan for your earlier wake
scenarios.body_template: Your selected wake is {wake_time}. A bedtime near {bedtime} leaves {need}, matching the current sleep-need estimate.
scenarios.delivery_window: Evaluate at 18:00 local on the preceding wake-schedule date; expire at the proposed bedtime or after 3 hours, whichever is earlier.
suppression: The earlier wake is a disabled weekday or obsolete override.
A timezone conversion rather than a user schedule change explains the difference.
The user already reviewed this plan revision.

Suppress if permission is unavailable, this occurrence was accepted, or its earlier scenario/family expiry passed. Apply proactive budgets and quiet hours only to discretionary pushes; selected-time reminders retain their reserved occurrence.
scenarios.acceptance: Given For an opted-in user with a confirmed local wake schedule and a canonical dynamic planning-need estimate whose actual source day, model and fallback tier are retained, evaluate the current plan revision; the next selected weekday wake is at least 60 minutes earlier than the preceding selected wake, and its calculated bedtime has not passed. When the eligible occurrence is evaluated within its delivery window, Then create one local_notification candidate titled "Plan for your earlier wake" with action "Review bedtime" to sleep.plan, preserving its source occurrence and expiry.
scenarios.rendered_body: Your selected wake is 06:00. A bedtime near 22:00 leaves 8 hours, matching the current sleep-need estimate.
scenarios.public_body: Your sleep information is ready to review.
